figures.Fig30.8: 13C NMR spectrum of an unknown molecule (PDF page 214). Original figure archived as c12-chem-ch30-fig-30-8-unknown-c13 (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book concludes the C4H10O compound is 2-methoxypropane after considering only three isomers. The printed shifts (69.0, 30.5, 19.0 ppm) fit 2-methylpropan-1-ol, while 2-methoxypropane would show two peaks above 50 ppm. Reported with a warning; flagged for review.
The exercises (PDF 214-216) are not part of the lesson body. The Quick Check questions are printed without answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.
